explanation.summary: NovaDesk’s approval function checks only whether the actor is a client. The disclosed bug is that it allows non-owner clients to approve milestones.

steps.title: Input data
steps.text: Actor provides an ID and a client or freelancer role. Milestone provides an ID, an ownerClientId, and an active or archived status.

steps.title: Actual approval decision
steps.text: canApproveMilestone returns true for clients and false for freelancers. It does not use the milestone parameter, so neither ownership nor status affects the result.

steps.title: Disclosed ownership gap
steps.text: For the supplied active-milestone scenarios, both client-owner and client-other receive true, while freelancer-1 receives false. Allowing client-other contradicts the stated owner-only requirement. The source comment explicitly identifies ownership as intentionally omitted.
